description: This Java class 'ShareProductDividendAssembler' calculates dividend payout details for share products in a financial application. It retrieves share account data, computes dividend shares over a period, and assembles payout details.

classes.name: ShareProductDividendAssembler
classes.description: A service class responsible for calculating and assembling dividend payout details for share products based on share account data and dividend periods.

methods.name: calculateDividends
methods.description: Calculates the dividend payout details for a specified share product over a dividend period, considering share purchase history and minimum active periods.

methods.name: calculateNumberOfShareDays
methods.description: Auxiliary method that calculates the total number of share days for all share accounts within the dividend period, factoring in purchase dates and statuses.
